Dear All,

I have a problem with displaying graphs. Hopefully you can help me. 
I try to run the examples. I run:

> library(shiny)
> runExample("01_hello")

Listening on port 8100

On the web browser there is a grey underlay-ed background. There is also the "Hello Shiny!" and a slider where I can select a number between 0 and 1000. 
But there is no result, there is no graph.  

The same with runExample("02_text")
On the left side I can choose the dataset and the nuber. But on the right side there is only a grey small box without any text inside. Also the table below is not shown.
